result.summary: The page layout is largely consistent, but one restaurant card displays a broken numeric value ('€NaN delivery'), indicating a data formatting/parsing bug. A minor styling inconsistency exists between the favorite buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a real delivery fee, exposing an unhandled null/undefined value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Validate the delivery fee before formatting; render '€0.00', 'Free delivery', or hide the fee line entirely when the value is missing or not a number.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second uses a dark/transparent background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single consistent favorite-button style (same background, icon color, and size) across all restaurant cards, ensuring adequate contrast over any image.
